observations.title: Trace an item's acquisition and uses
observations.player_action: Hover an item and press R for recipes or U for uses; click/right-click entries in the item list for the same views.
observations.outcome: The recipe viewer distinguishes producing an item from consuming it.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Recipe display is discovery, not crafting completion. Use exact server recipe/result or native action signals for quests; no JEI UI click is automatically a progression event.

observations.title: Narrow the recipe catalogue
observations.player_action: Use Ctrl+F to focus search, @ for a mod, - to exclude, quoted phrases and | for alternative searches.
observations.outcome: Search combines terms and filters instead of requiring knowledge of every item name.
conditions: Advanced prefix semantics can differ by Minecraft/tag generation; inspect installed help before assuming old OreDictionary terminology.

observations.title: Transfer available ingredients to a crafting grid
observations.player_action: Open a recipe and use its + control; shift-click for multiple sets.
observations.outcome: A supported transfer handler moves available ingredients into the crafting area; it does not grant missing materials.
conditions: The author lists transfer as limited on client-only installations for Minecraft 1.21.1 and older.

observations.title: Distinguish viewing, hiding and cheating
observations.player_action: Use Ctrl+O to toggle the item list and inspect its configured edit/cheat modes.
observations.outcome: Normal recipe browsing is distinct from item hiding or permission-dependent item spawning/deletion.
conditions: Do not treat a JEI icon or recipe display as proof an item is obtainable under effective JEM recipes.
